<!-- begin fit-mig-radiation -->
The two lines of [](#fig-mig-radiation) are $C/N$ with $C = 93$ and $C = 211$. The first coefficient is the geometric mean, over the 6 rows of the Aramis line with beamlets of 4, of the lower end of the range multiplied by the number of macroparticles per slice, and the second is that of the upper end. The 6 products lie between 82 and 102 for the lower end and between 205 and 221 for the upper end.
